def transform(grid):
    """Overlay nonzero cells above and below the unique separator row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                  if 0 < r < h - 1 and len(set(row)) == 1]
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("missing solid divider")
    divider, _ = min(
        candidates,
        key=lambda candidate: sum(
            cell == candidate[1]
            for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r != candidate[0]
            for cell in row))
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("panels must have equal height")
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
